title: #3 Compact press-fit
insertion_note: Push plugs into opposite ends, metal tips toward the center. Only the front 3.2 mm of each plastic housing is captured. Test PLA flex without forcing it.
retention_note: Original #3 cavity/mouth widths and heights, a shorter 0.8 mm throat, and 0.8 mm flanking relief slots.

title: #5 Compact side-entry
insertion_note: Slide the housing and metal tip sideways through the stepped opening, then move the plug 0.8 mm inward. Reverse that move before sliding out.
retention_note: Mirrored side entrances with lead-ins, localized rounded housing detents (6.25 mm gap), and a closed side wall capturing the last 0.8 mm of the tip.

title: #9 Compact ribbed push-in
insertion_note: Push each plug into an end. Rounded ribs grip the plastic housing; most of the housing remains exposed.
retention_note: Two opposing rib pairs per end project 0.2 mm, span 8 mm, have 0.8 mm axial bases, and sit 1.3/2.5 mm inside the opening. Metal-tip pockets stay smooth.
rib_axis: vertical side-wall ribs, rooted in floor and roof
